description: OpenSearch 3.9.0 Index State Management: policy CRUD (normalized output, seq_no/primary_term concurrency, every validation message and parse position), ism_template conflicts and auto-management (hidden and auto_manage=false indices excluded), add/remove/change_policy/retry/explain on index expressions and aliases, and explain before the plugin's first job run. Capture on a fresh node (explain steps wait for the plugin's asynchronous registration).
